interface.title: agatesim v0.1.0
interface.stage_of_work: Exploratory simulation and checking a hypothesis: generate agate slabs and volumes from rule-based and mechanistic models, then test them against measurable criteria for each archetype form
interface.what_it_is_for: Simulate how agate bands fill a host-rock cavity, using rule-based or physical-mechanism models, and judge each 2D slab or random 3D cut against measurable criteria for a target agate form.

data.note: All results came from the shipped verified presets (13 archetype forms × procedural/mechanistic tiers, plus 3D presets) and from parameter changes I made. The Specimens screen needs agate photos. None were available, so its Library stayed empty and Reference labels showed '331 not fetched yet'.

tree.general: Find out whether a model, by design or from a proposed mechanism, produces a target natural pattern, and how robust that result is
tree.specific: Make an agate form (fortification, botryoidal, moss) with procedural and mechanistic models, and judge slabs and 3D cuts against the archetype criteria

features.name: Preset picker with pass/fail criteria table
features.general: Pick a target category and a modelling approach, load its verified configuration, and see a table of measurable criteria with value, threshold and pass/fail/not-judged status
features.specific: Form dropdown with Procedural/Mechanistic tier toggle loads a verified preset. The Archetype tests table and Band statistics update with the live preview.
steps: choose a form in the Form dropdown
read the archetype tests (pass / not judged) and band statistics
serves_tasks: Load the reference settings for a chosen target pattern and see whether it meets the criteria
Switch the same target to the mechanism-based model and compare its pattern metrics

features.name: Two-approach side-by-side gallery
features.general: For each category in a list, show the result of two modelling approaches next to each other, with the same criteria judging both and a list of what each one sets directly
features.specific: Two ways screen: a list of 13 forms on the left, with Rule-based and From a mechanism panels, their test tables and 'Open in the simulator'
steps: click a form in the list
optionally open either one in the simulator
serves_tasks: Compare both modelling approaches for a target side by side

features.name: Constrained randomizer with undo/redo history
features.general: Randomly perturb parameters by a chosen amount, optionally keep only draws that still satisfy the target criteria, and step back or forward through the history
features.specific: Randomize with How far (Subtle to Wild), 'Stay within the form', Also vary cavity, a progress bar showing 'Checking draw n of up to 12', and Undo / Reset (n changed) / Redo
steps: press Randomize and watch the draws being checked
inspect the result and the changed count
serves_tasks: Randomly perturb key parameters while keeping only draws that still meet the target criteria

features.name: Boundary shape catalogue plus polygon drawing dialog
features.general: Choose a domain boundary from a visual catalogue, or draw your own by clicking corners or drawing freehand, then use it in the simulation
features.specific: Cavity tiles (vesicle, nodule and seam shapes) and a 'draw…' modal with Click corners/Freehand, Angular/Smooth and Host options, Undo/Clear and 'Use this shape'
steps: click a cavity tile, or press draw…
click corners and close on the first
the preview re-renders in the new cavity
serves_tasks: Change the boundary geometry, from a catalogue or drawn by hand

features.name: Rendering-mode switch with angle sliders
features.general: Switch an image between rendering modes, each with its own lighting or viewing-angle controls
features.specific: Slab / Shadow (light angle) / Iris (view angle, direction) radio group above the preview
steps: press Iris and set View angle and Direction
serves_tasks: View the result under alternative optical renderings

features.name: Growth timeline scrubber with animation export
features.general: Scrub or play the time course of a simulation, optionally in sync across two compared panels, and export it as an animation
features.specific: Growth slider with play button, speed, Loop, 'Grow both together' when a run is pinned, and Save the growth as GIF/MP4. The explorer only dragged the shared Growth slider; GIF export was confirmed only by the replay (downloaded fortification-drawn-growth.gif), and MP4 was never tried.
steps: drag the Growth slider or press play
tick Grow both together when comparing
serves_tasks: Pin a reference result and compare later results with it: images, criteria, differing settings, statistics

features.name: 3D volume with an adjustable section plane
features.general: Rotate a 3D volume and set a section plane by tilt, direction and offset, or by standard views, then see and measure that section
features.specific: 3D view (drag to turn) and 'The cut' panel, with Front/Side/Top, the Cut tilt/direction/offset sliders, Open at the cut, Face the cut, and tests and band statistics for the cut
steps: read the tests for the cut
serves_tasks: Build a 3D volume and inspect chosen cross-sections

features.name: Random-section survey with filterable gallery
features.general: Sample N random sections of a volume, judge each against criteria, report the pass rate per criterion and per condition bin, and browse a pass/fail-filtered thumbnail gallery that loads any section in full
features.specific: Random cuts: choose 20/40/100 cuts, then Survey random cuts. The result gives '35% of 20 cuts pass', a criteria table with gravity bins and apparent/true thickness, and an All/Passing/Failing gallery. Clicking a cut loads it as the active cut.
steps: press Survey random cuts and watch progress
read the pass rate and breakdown
click a thumbnail to load that cut
serves_tasks: Estimate how often a random section shows the target pattern

features.name: Background run queue with status badges
features.general: Queue high-resolution runs in the background and list them with a status and pass/fail badge
features.specific: Choose Resolution, press Run full resolution; the Runs list shows waiting/running/PASS/FAIL with a Delete link for each run
steps: watch the run go from waiting to running to PASS/FAIL in the Runs list
serves_tasks: Run a high-resolution version in the background and get a pass/fail verdict

features.name: Pinned comparison with settings diff and paired statistics
features.general: Pin one result as a reference and view another result or the live state beside it, with both criteria tables, a table of settings that differ and paired statistics
features.specific: 'Pin for comparison' / Unpin on a run, side-by-side panels for another run or the Live preview, the What differs table, the two-column Band statistics, and 'Use these settings'
steps: open a run and press Pin for comparison
open another run or the Live preview
compare the two images and test tables
read What differs and the paired statistics
serves_tasks: Pin a reference result and compare later results with it: images, criteria, differing settings, statistics

features.name: Self-contained HTML report export
features.general: Export one result as a standalone HTML report with the image, settings, seed and code version
features.specific: Export report downloads <run>-report.html (embedded PNG, model, resolution, seed, commit; whether it includes the tests table was not confirmed)
steps: open a run or the preview
serves_tasks: Export a self-contained report of a result
